تستغربوا (form X)
# تَسْتَغْرِبُوا (tastaḡribū) /tas.taɣ.ri.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَغْرَبَ (istaḡraba)
# تُسْتَغْرَبُوا (tustaḡrabū) /tus.taɣ.ra.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَغْرَبَ (istaḡraba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
